questions.stem: One forcep was left in the abdomen after surgery. What does this implicate?
questions.solutionHtml:
Res ipsa loquitur

Pair of surgical scissors left behind in the abdomen after surgery. The offence comes under res ipsa loquitur .



KSN Reddy Essential Textbook of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, 33rd edition, Page number- 38.

questions.stem: Which of the following is not a cardiac poison:
questions.solutionHtml:
Atropa Belladonna

Atropa belladonna is a deliriant poison that acts by inhibiting the muscarinic effects of acetylcholine.



KSN Reddy Essential Textbook of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, 33rd edition, Page number- 615.

questions.stem: Skin tattooing around the entry wound from a gun of a bullet is due to:
questions.solutionHtml:
Unburnt particles

Tattooing -Partly burnt/unburnt gun powder particles.Around entry wound, they are adherent to the skin. It cannot be wiped away and felt as sharpones. This is called tattooing / stippling / peppering.



KSN Reddy Essential Textbook of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, 33rd edition, Page number- 217,218.

questions.stemHtml: Identify the image given below:
questions.solutionHtml:
Abrasion

Abrasion, also known as gravel rash, is the destruction of superficial layers of the epidermis. It is caused by friction against a rough surface or by compression.

questions.stem: What is the most common cause of death in cold water Drowning? -
questions.solutionHtml:
Vasovagal Inhibition

The most common cause of death in cold water Drowning is Vasovagal Inhibition because cold water stimulates nerve endings & water striking epigastrium causes Vagal inhibition → Cardiac arrest → death.



KSN Reddy Essential Textbook of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, 33rd edition, Page number- 112
